summary: Canada Goose filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release disclosing that CEO and Chair Dani Reiss, through his holding company DTR LLC, acquired 100,000 subordinate voting shares on the TSX and other Canadian published markets on September 9, 2026, at prices of C$10.555 to C$10.695, averaging about C$10.623, for roughly C$1,062,300. The purchase lifts his SVS to 219,413 (0.48%) while he retains 20,130,334 multiple voting shares (39.47%), about 21.00% of total shares and 36.28% of votes. Filed for investment purposes under the normal-course purchase exemption; no special-situation transaction. Watch for further early-warning filings and any creeping-control implications.
